collection.title: SEAT Ibiza Hatchback 2002 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Ibiza Hatchback 2002 to 2006 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Ibiza which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
